text_en: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to the young man who carried his armor, “Come, let us go over to the Philistine garrison on the other side. ” But he did not tell his father.
text_cn: 有一天，撒乌耳的儿子约纳堂对他执戟的侍卫说：“来，我们到对面，到培肋舍特人的前哨那里去。”但他没有通知他父亲。

text_en: Saul was staying in the outskirts of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree that is at Migron; the troops that were with him were about six hundred men,
text_cn: 当时撒乌耳正在革巴边界，坐在禾场旁的石榴树下，随从他的部队约有六百人。

text_en: along with Ahijah son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, son of Phinehas son of Eli, the priest of the Lord in Shiloh, carrying an ephod. Now the people did not know that Jonathan had gone.
text_cn: 阿希突布的儿子阿希雅带着“厄弗得”。──阿希突布是丕乃哈斯的儿子，依加波得的兄弟，丕乃哈斯是在史罗作上主司祭的厄里的儿子。──人都不知道约纳堂走了。

text_en: In the pass, by which Jonathan tried to go over to the Philistine garrison, there was a rocky crag on one side and a rocky crag on the other; the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
text_cn: 约纳堂打算由隘口过到培肋舍特人的前哨那里去，在隘口两面各有一座石峰：一名叫波责兹，一名叫色乃；

text_en: One crag rose on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.
text_cn: 一座朝北，与米革玛斯相对，一座朝南，与革巴相对。

text_en: Jonathan said to the young man who carried his armor, “Come, let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised; it may be that the Lord will act for us; for nothing can hinder the Lord from saving by many or by few. ”
text_cn: 约纳堂于是对他执戟的侍卫说：“来，我们往这些未受割损者的前哨去，也许上主会帮助我们；上主要叫人得胜，并不在乎人数多少。

text_en: His armor-bearer said to him, “Do all that your mind inclines to. I am with you; as your mind is, so is mine. ”
text_cn: 那给他执戟的人答说：“你尽可随意行事，我只跟着你，随你心意而行。”

text_en: Then Jonathan said, “Now we will cross over to those men and will show ourselves to them.
text_cn: 约纳堂说：“来，我们到那边去，让他们看见我们。

text_en: If they say to us, ‘Wait until we come to you, ’ then we will stand still in our place, and we will not go up to them.
text_cn: 假使他们对我们说：住下！等我们到你们那里去。我们就站在我们所在的地方，不再上他们那里去；

text_en: But if they say, ‘Come up to us, ’ then we will go up; for the Lord has given them into our hand. That will be the sign for us. ”
text_cn: 如果他们说：你们上我们这里来吧！我们就上去，因为上主已把他们交在我们手中了：这为我们是个先兆。”

text_en: So both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Look, Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they have hidden themselves. ”
text_cn: 两人就突然出现在培肋舍特人的前哨处，培肋舍特人说：“看，这些希伯来人从他们隐藏的山洞中出来了。”

text_en: The men of the garrison hailed Jonathan and his armor-bearer, saying, “Come up to us, and we will show you something. ” Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, “Come up after me; for the Lord has given them into the hand of Israel. ”
text_cn: 前哨的哨兵就对约纳堂和给他执戟的人说：“你们上到我们这里来吧！我们有事要告诉你们。”约纳堂就对给他执戟的人说：“你跟我上来，因为上主已将他们交在以色列人手中了。”

text_en: Then Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer following after him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer, coming after him, killed them.
text_cn: 约纳堂遂用手用脚往上爬，给他执戟的跟在他后面。培肋舍特人忽在约纳堂前转身要走，他就向前击杀他们，他的执戟者也随着击杀。

text_en: In that first slaughter Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed about twenty men within an area about half a furrow long in an acre of land.
text_cn: 约纳堂和他的执戟者第一次杀死了约有二十人，陈尸于半亩田间。

text_en: There was a panic in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and even the raiders trembled; the earth quaked; and it became a very great panic.
text_cn: 当时在营中和阵地上都起了恐慌，全军──前哨与突击队都大为震惊；地也起了震动，到处笼罩着无限的恐怖。

text_en: Saul’s lookouts in Gibeah of Benjamin were watching as the multitude was surging back and forth.
text_cn: 撒乌耳的哨兵从本雅明的革巴眺望，看见敌营大乱；

text_en: Then Saul said to the troops that were with him, “Call the roll and see who has gone from us. ” When they had called the roll, Jonathan and his armor-bearer were not there.
text_cn: 撒乌耳就对随从他的人说：“检查一下，看我们中有谁去了。”他们检查后，见约纳堂和给他执戟的人不在了。

text_en: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the ark of God here. ” For at that time the ark of God went with the Israelites.
text_cn: 撒乌耳遂对阿希雅说：“拿天主的‘厄弗得’来！”因为那时正是他在以色列子民前带着天主的“厄弗得”。

text_en: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the camp of the Philistines increased more and more; and Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳还同司祭说话时，培肋舍特人营中的混乱愈来愈大，撒乌耳就对司祭说：“收回你的手去！”

text_en: Then Saul and all the people who were with him rallied and went into the battle; and every sword was against the other, so that there was very great confusion.
text_cn: 撒乌耳和跟随他的军民遂集合起来，冲入战场；看，培肋舍特人竟自相残杀，陷入混乱。

text_en: Now the Hebrews who previously had been with the Philistines and had gone up with them into the camp turned and joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
text_cn: 以前服事培肋舍特人，与他们齐来参战的希伯来人，忽然反过来协助撒乌耳和约纳堂一起的以色列人。

text_en: Likewise, when all the Israelites who had gone into hiding in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing, they too followed closely after them in the battle.
text_cn: 那藏在厄弗辣因山地的以色列人，听说培肋舍特人溃败了，也都出来参战，乘势追赶。

text_en: So the Lord gave Israel the victory that day. The battle passed beyond Beth-aven, and the troops with Saul numbered altogether about ten thousand men. The battle spread out over the hill country of Ephraim.
text_cn: 这样上主在那一天拯救了以色列人；战争一直蔓延到贝特曷龙。【跟随撒乌耳的人约有一万，战事蔓延到厄弗辣因整个山地。】

text_en: Now Saul committed a very rash act on that day. He had laid an oath on the troops, saying, “Cursed be anyone who eats food before it is evening and I have been avenged on my enemies. ” So none of the troops tasted food.
text_cn: 以色列人那天很是疲乏，因为撒乌耳在那天做了一件糊涂事，要军民发誓说：“谁直到晚上，在我向敌人复仇以前，吃了什么东西，是可咒骂的。”所以全军民都没有尝过食物。

text_en: All the troops came upon a honeycomb; and there was honey on the ground.
text_cn: 那地方到处有蜂巢，地面上到处有蜜。

text_en: When the troops came upon the honeycomb, the honey was dripping out; but they did not put their hands to their mouths, for they feared the oath.
text_cn: 军民到了蜂巢旁，见有蜜流出，但却没有人敢用手取一点放在嘴里，因为军民都怕违犯所起的誓。

text_en: But Jonathan had not heard his father charge the troops with the oath; so he extended the staff that was in his hand, and dipped the tip of it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.
text_cn: 可是约纳堂没有听见他父亲要军民起的誓，所以把他手中所持的棍尖，插入蜂巢内，用手送到自己的嘴里，他的眼立即明亮了。

text_en: Then one of the soldiers said, “Your father strictly charged the troops with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed be anyone who eats food this day. ’ And so the troops are faint. ”
text_cn: 军民中有一个向他说：“你父亲要军民起誓说：今天谁尝了食物，他是可咒骂的。──虽然军民很是疲乏。”

text_en: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land; see how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
text_cn: 约纳堂答说：“我父亲使国家受了害；你们看，尝了一点蜜，我的眼睛是多么明亮！

text_en: How much better if today the troops had eaten freely of the spoil taken from their enemies; for now the slaughter among the Philistines has not been great. ”
text_cn: 的确，假使今天人能吃饱由敌人夺来的东西，培肋舍特人吃的败仗，岂不更大吗？”

text_en: After they had struck down the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon, the troops were very faint;
text_cn: 那一天他们击杀培肋舍特人，从米革玛斯直到阿雅隆，军民都很疲乏。

text_en: so the troops flew upon the spoil, and took sheep and oxen and calves, and slaughtered them on the ground; and the troops ate them with the blood.
text_cn: 所以人民就急忙抢掠财物，夺取牛羊、牛犊，随地宰杀，吃了带血的肉。

text_en: Then it was reported to Saul, “Look, the troops are sinning against the Lord by eating with the blood. ” And he said, “You have dealt treacherously; roll a large stone before me here. ”
text_cn: 有人告诉撒乌耳说：“看，人民吃了带血的肉，得罪了上主。”撒乌耳一听这消息便说：“你们把一块大石头滚到我这边来。”

text_en: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the troops, and say to them, ‘Let all bring their oxen or their sheep, and slaughter them here, and eat; and do not sin against the Lord by eating with the blood. ’” So all of the troops brought their oxen with them that night, and slaughtered them there.
text_cn: 又说：“你们散在百姓中，对他们说：你们各人把自己得的牛或羊，牵到我这里来，在这里宰杀分食，不要吃带血的肉，得罪上主。”于是人们当夜将自己得的牛羊牵来，在那里祭杀了。

text_en: And Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first altar that he built to the Lord .
text_cn: 撒乌耳给上主建筑了一座祭坛，这是他给上主建立的第一座祭坛。

text_en: Then Saul said, “Let us go down after the Philistines by night and despoil them until the morning light; let us not leave one of them. ” They said, “Do whatever seems good to you. ” But the priest said, “Let us draw near to God here. ”
text_cn: 以后撒乌耳说：“我们今夜下去追击培肋舍特人，劫掠他们直到天明，不给他们留下一人。”军民回答说：“你看着怎样好，就怎样作吧！”司祭却说：“我们先得去天主那里。”

text_en: So Saul inquired of God, “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you give them into the hand of Israel? ” But he did not answer him that day.
text_cn: 撒乌耳遂求问天主说：“我可下去追击培肋舍特人吗？你将他们交在以色列手中吗？”但是天主那天没有回答他。

text_en: Saul said, “Come here, all you leaders of the people; and let us find out how this sin has arisen today.
text_cn: 撒乌耳说：“军民的将领，你们上前来，查看一下，今天是谁犯了罪？

text_en: For as the Lord lives who saves Israel, even if it is in my son Jonathan, he shall surely die! ” But there was no one among all the people who answered him.
text_cn: 我指拯救以色列的上主起誓，即是罪在我的儿子约纳堂，他也该死。”军民中没有一人敢回答。

text_en: He said to all Israel, “You shall be on one side, and I and my son Jonathan will be on the other side. ” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you. ”
text_cn: 于是他对全以色列说：“你们站在一边，我与我儿子约纳堂站在一边。”全军民对撒乌耳说：“你看怎样好，就怎样作吧！”

text_en: Then Saul said, “O Lord God of Israel, why have you not answered your servant today? If this guilt is in me or in my son Jonathan, O Lord God of Israel, give Urim; but if this guilt is in your people Israel, give Thummim. ” And Jonathan and Saul were indicated by the lot, but the people were cleared.
text_cn: 撒乌耳说：“上主，以色列的天主！为什么今天你不答复你的仆人！若是这罪过在我或我儿子约纳堂身上，上主，以色列的天主，求你赐给‘乌陵’；若是罪过在你百姓以色列身上，求你赐给‘突明’。”撒乌耳和约纳堂中了，军民清白无过。

text_en: Then Saul said, “Cast the lot between me and my son Jonathan. ” And Jonathan was taken.
text_cn: 撒乌耳下命说：“为我和我的儿子约纳堂拈阄。”约纳堂中了。

text_en: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done. ” Jonathan told him, “I tasted a little honey with the tip of the staff that was in my hand; here I am, I will die. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳于是对约纳堂说：“告诉我，你作了什么？”约纳堂就告诉他说：“我不过用手持的棍尖，蘸了一点蜂蜜吃；我在这里，我该死。”

text_en: Saul said, “God do so to me and more also; you shall surely die, Jonathan! ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳回答说：“约纳堂，你必须死，不然，愿天主罚我，且重重罚我！”

text_en: Then the people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has accomplished this great victory in Israel? Far from it! As the Lord lives, not one hair of his head shall fall to the ground; for he has worked with God today. ” So the people ransomed Jonathan, and he did not die.
text_cn: 军民却对撒乌耳说：“约纳堂在以色列中得了这样伟大的胜利，岂该死吗？万万不能！我们指着上主起誓：他头上的一根头发，也不应落在地上，因为他今天是倚赖天主行事。”这样军民救了约纳堂不死，

text_en: Then Saul withdrew from pursuing the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.
text_cn: 撒乌耳遂上去，不再追赶培肋舍特人；培肋舍特人也回了本地。

text_en: When Saul had taken the kingship over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side—against Moab, against the Ammonites, against Edom, against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines; wherever he turned he routed them.
text_cn: 撒乌耳取得了以色列的王权后，便向四周所有的敌人进攻：他攻打了摩阿布、阿孟子民、厄东、贝特勒曷布、祚巴的君王和培肋舍特人。他不论走到哪里，常获得胜利。

text_en: He did valiantly, and struck down the Amalekites, and rescued Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.
text_cn: 他很是英勇，击败了阿玛肋克，拯救以色列人脱离来抢掠的人。

text_en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn was Merab, and the name of the younger, Michal.
text_cn: 撒乌耳的儿子是：约纳堂、依市伟和玛耳基叔亚；他有两个女儿：长女名叫默辣布，次女名叫米加耳。

text_en: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army was Abner son of Ner, Saul’s uncle;
text_cn: 撒乌耳的妻子名叫阿希诺罕，是阿希玛兹的女儿。他的元帅名叫阿贝乃尔，是撒乌耳的叔父乃尔的儿子。

text_en: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
text_cn: 撒乌耳的父亲克士和阿贝乃尔的父亲乃尔是阿彼耳的儿子。

text_en: There was hard fighting against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any strong or valiant warrior, he took him into his service.
text_cn: 撒乌耳一生同培肋舍特人常发生激烈战争，撒乌耳见到任何勇敢善战的人，就叫他来跟随自己。
